---
title: "reference-dfs"
format: html
---

Code in this qmd can be used to create small tibbles to reference when writing code to clean data

```{r}
multispeaker_lines <- test4 |> 
  select(season, episode, type, speaker, speaker_note, transcript) |>
  filter(type == "dialogue") |>
  filter(str_detect(speaker, ",|&|\\s(?i)and\\s|/")) |> 
  collect()
```

```{r}
previously_episodes <- test4 |>
  select(season, episode, type, transcript) |>
  filter(type == "previously") |>
  select(-c(type, transcript)) |>
  arrange(season, episode) |> 
  collect()
```
